name: Staging Deploy with Approval

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - staging

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - name: Build Maven project
        run: mvn clean package

  notify_for_approval:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Send Deployment Approval Email
        run: |
          curl -s --user 'api:${{ secrets.MAILGUN_API_KEY }}' \
            https://api.mailgun.net/v3/${{ secrets.MAILGUN_DOMAIN }}/messages \
            -F from='GitHub Actions <mailgun@${{ secrets.MAILGUN_DOMAIN }}>' \
            -F to='reviewer@example.com' \
            -F subject='Deployment to Staging Awaiting Approval' \
            -F text='A new deployment to staging is ready for your review. Please visit the GitHub Actions page to approve or reject.'

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, notify_for_approval]
    environment:
      name: staging
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup SSH
        uses: webfactory/ssh-agent@v0.9.0
        with:
          ssh-private-key: ${{ secrets.STAGING_KEY }}

      - name: Deploy to staging server
        run: rsync -avz --delete target/ ${{ secrets.STAGING_USER }}@${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}:/var/www/myapp/

      - name: Send Deployment Success Email
        if: success()
        run: |
          curl -s --user 'api:${{ secrets.MAILGUN_API_KEY }}' \
            https://api.mailgun.net/v3/${{ secrets.MAILGUN_DOMAIN }}/messages \
            -F from='GitHub Actions <mailgun@${{ secrets.MAILGUN_DOMAIN }}>' \
            -F to='stakeholder@example.com' \
            -F subject='Staging Deployment Successful' \
            -F text='The new deployment to staging has been completed successfully.'
